text:
anya: Quick question — we're about to publish the deprecation notice for the implicit default model flip. Do we have a documented gracepath for clients that rely on the old implicit default?
kevin: Short answer: yes, but we need to confirm rollout windows and the exact fallback behavior.
maria: My concern is mobile SDKs that don't set Accept-Model. We should avoid sudden breaks.
lars: Agreed. Current plan on the RFC was: 90-day grace where Accept-Model missing => server chooses previous default and logs a deprecation metric. After 90 days, missing header will map to the new default.
anya: Can we make that 120 days? A couple of big customers asked for extra runway.
jordan: 120 seems fine if we add a feature-flagged extension to extend per-customer. Ops will need a per-tenant override for enterprise accounts.
kevin: Implementation detail: we'll support both behaviors behind a toggle. Default rollout: 90d, but we can flip to 120d per-tenant by setting cookie/override at the routing layer.
maria: What about a visible response header to help clients detect this? e.g., `X-Redwood-Model-Routed: previous|new` and `X-Redwood-Deprecation-ETA: 2026-07-01`
lars: I like that. Add `X-Redwood-Model-Version` too for exact model id. Helps debug.
ops-bot: NOTE: routing toggles require a deploy to route-config service and a migration window for the config database. ETA ~2 days once approved.
anya: Who owns the doc for the comms? I can draft the user-facing note if someone provides exact dates and fallback semantics.
jordan: I'll own dates. Can we commit to a start date next Tuesday? If so, @maria can QA mobile SDK flows and @kevin can validate server mapping.
kevin: I can validate mapping. Quick pseudo example for the header behavior:
```
# server routing pseudocode
if Accept-Model provided:
  route to requested model
else:
  if now < grace_until:
    route to previous_default_model
  else:
    route to new_default_model
```

maria: For SDKs we'll add telemetry to surface `Accept-Model` presence and the `X-Redwood-Model-Version` in crash logs. Need the exact header names before I ship.
lars: Header names above look good. Also add `X-Redwood-Deprecation-Warn: true` in responses during the grace period so clients can programmatically detect upcoming flips.
anya: Good. For the deprecation notice copy I'll include: short summary, dates, migration steps (set Accept-Model, test with `X-Redwood-Model-Version`), and contact support link.
ops-bot: ACTION: create route-config PR and schedule canary. Assignee: kevin.
jordan: I'll set the start date to 2026-07-13 and the end of grace to 2026-11-10 (120 days). If anyone objects ping me now.
maria: No objections from mobile. I'll start SDK telemetry changes and send a PR by EOD Friday.
kevin: I'll open the route-config PR and include the per-tenant override flags. Also will add a healthcheck that verifies X-Redwood-Model-Version is present.
anya: Thanks. Once PRs are up I'll draft the customer-facing blog + in-console banner.
lars: Small ask — add a compatibility test in nightly CI that runs both defaults through our eval suite to detect perf/regressions when the default changes.
jordan: Good call. I'll add a Percy job to run a smoke eval on both model ids nightly for 2 weeks post-flip.
anya: Sounds good. Filing this as accepted plan. I'll drop the comms draft into #product-comms and link back here. :thumbsup:
